podcast.body: This song, released in 1977, was found to be awfully similar to Elastica's song "Waking Up." As a result, "a piece of that first Elastica album was awarded to the Stranglers." The situation was characterized as "an actual case of, well, there's no way to get around it, theft, a well-intentioned theft, but theft nonetheless." "The Stranglers, a British band that was formed in 1974, noticed that the Elastica song waking up sounded awfully like one of their songs from 1977 called No More Heroes."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
